text: The cottage glows with candlelight. Mother has baked a honey cake, and Ros is bouncing on her toes.
"Did you get me something? Did you, did you?"
Ros squeals and throws her arms around you. "It's perfect! You're the best!"
Ros's face falls. She says nothing, but she doesn't look at you for the rest of supper.
Later, as the candles gutter, Father goes to the window and goes very still. There is smoke rising from the woods.
